# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED's top pick. It has a chrome "tree" design, charges the iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has a 2-year warranty. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy. It lists at $109, with WIRED showing $98, $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. I wasn't given a direct product link, so the review is here: [WIRED's best 3-in-1 Apple chargers](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest, if you have an iPhone 16 or 17: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2, 25W).** It has an active cooling fan, a 50W adapter in the box, a 30-day return window, and a 12-month warranty (24 months if you register). A Dealectric page reports that code PARTNER18 took $17.99 off, bringing the $99.99 price to about $82 at ESR's US store. The code was tested on Oct 23, so confirm it at checkout. Dealectric earns a commission on the link below at no cost to you.
- [Buy at ESR (via Dealectric)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- [Details and caveats](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)

Only the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus get the full 25W. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W. WIRED liked the fan but found the plastic build less premium. It also noted the fan has an off button for sleeping. WIRED lists it at $100 on Amazon.

**Other good picks**
- **Nomad Stand One Max ($169):** 25W Qi2, premium glossy build, and a heavy base that allows one-handed phone removal. It doesn't include a power adapter, so you need a 40W one. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Nimble Podium ($130):** Lies flat so screens stay dark overnight, and supports 25W. Apple Watch charging is slow. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99):** Tallest and most adjustable of the foldable stands, with a 45W adapter and travel plugs. It's also the one to choose if you travel. ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))
- **Budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15W):** WIRED's cheapest Qi2-certified pick, listed at $80 and shown at $40 on Amazon. The Apple Watch charger is a detachable unit. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**How to choose**
- If you mostly charge overnight, 25W makes little difference. WIRED calls 15W models like Belkin's and Anker's plenty, and Belkin is the better value.
- If you want fast top-ups on a recent iPhone, get the ESR CryoBoost, or the Nomad if you want a more premium feel.
- Your AirPods case must support wireless charging. The original AirPods case doesn't.
